subtopic: 04 · Graphs and Periodicity of Trigonometric Functions
title: Composite and identity periods

board_content.text: Each of $|\sin x|,|\cos x|$ has period $\pi$. But $|\cos x|=|\sin(x+\tfrac{\pi}{2})|$, so the sum repeats sooner.
A hidden shrink: the sum's period is smaller than either part. Don't just take the larger.
So $\sin^2 x$ has period $\pi$, not $2\pi$ \u2014 squaring halves the period here.

segments_english.text: These two show that periods can shrink in ways you must watch for.

Take the absolute value of sine x plus the absolute value of cosine x. Each absolute value on its own has period pi. But the absolute value of cosine x is the same as the absolute value of sine of x plus pi over two, so the two swap roles.
Push x forward by pi over two and the sum returns to itself: it becomes absolute cosine plus absolute sine, exactly f of x again. No smaller shift works, so the period is pi over two.
This is a hidden shrink. The sum repeats faster than either piece alone, so never just take the larger of the two periods, check carefully.
Example five: the period of sine squared x.
Use the power-reduction identity: sine squared x equals one minus cosine two x, all over two. The only moving part is cosine two x, which has period two pi over two, that is pi.
So sine squared x has period pi, not two pi. Squaring the sine has quietly halved its period.

segments_hinglish.text: ये दोनों दिखाते हैं कि periods ऐसे तरीक़ों से shrink हो सकते हैं जिनका ध्यान ज़रूरी है.

Absolute value of sine x plus absolute value of cosine x लीजिए. हर absolute value अकेले का period pi है. पर absolute value of cosine x वही है जो absolute value of sine of x plus pi over two, so दोनों roles swap कर लेते हैं.
x को pi over two आगे बढ़ाइए और sum ख़ुद पर लौट आता है: बनता है absolute cosine plus absolute sine, फिर exactly f of x. इससे छोटा shift काम नहीं करता, so period pi over two.
ये hidden shrink है. Sum किसी भी अकेले piece से तेज़ repeat होता है, so कभी सिर्फ़ बड़ा वाला period मत लीजिए, ध्यान से check कीजिए.
Example पाँच: sine squared x का period.
Power-reduction identity use कीजिए: sine squared x equals one minus cosine two x, पूरे over two. एकमात्र moving part है cosine two x, जिसका period two pi over two, यानी pi.
So sine squared x का period pi है, two pi नहीं. Sine को square करने ने चुपचाप उसका period आधा कर दिया.
